target: Pilot aiming at 4 complete paragraphs per existing class; retain ambiguity and report missing coverage instead of forcing quotas.
sampling: Editorial paragraph units, 120-250 words, original Spanish body text. No model predictions. Candidate labels by first reviewer then blind agent review before adjudication. Negative controls may use intact bibliographic runs and outside-period paragraphs.
dependence: Three articles share a dossier; conservatively one collection group, not three independent evaluation domains. Check quotations/citations and lexical overlap with existing TRAIN. Any uncertain derivative paragraph remains quarantined.
training: Twelve existing TRAIN contrast passages separately reviewed blind; no new rows applied. Existing TRAIN works cannot supply evaluation.
